propositions: Older rebar binaries reading a store that syncs multiple tracker projects create duplicate issues by fetching only their single configured project and missing other projects' bound tickets
The multi-project-bridge capability must be registered in KNOWN_CAPABILITIES to enable binaries to recognize and fail closed on incompatible stores rather than corrupt them
A binary without the multi-project-bridge capability must refuse write operations to a store declaring that capability while allowing reads (list/show/search)
A store with no store-compat.json record must continue to pass through as implicit legacy for backward compatibility
A malformed store-compat.json record must raise an error rather than be treated as absent to prevent capability check bypass
